name: Jobs to Be Done
best_for: Understanding progress customers seek and contexts of use
avoid_when: No actual customer context is available

name: Continuous Discovery / Opportunity Solution Trees
best_for: Connecting observed needs, possible solutions and experiments to an outcome
avoid_when: No customer interviews or outcome definition yet

name: Product Operating Model
best_for: Assigning outcomes and problems to empowered cross-functional product teams
avoid_when: The engagement is a fixed deliverable without product ownership

name: Shape Up
best_for: Shaping bounded, high-judgment bets with explicit appetite
avoid_when: Work is incident response or tightly prescribed

name: Business Model Canvas
best_for: Mapping relationships among customers, value, activities and economics
avoid_when: Used as substitute for empirical testing

name: Value Proposition Canvas
best_for: Connecting customer jobs, obstacles and desired gains to offers

name: Design Sprint
best_for: Reducing risk rapidly with prototype/customer testing
avoid_when: Unclear problem or inaccessible target users

name: Wardley Mapping
best_for: Mapping user needs, value chains and capability evolution
avoid_when: Domain knowledge is too thin to map dependencies responsibly

name: Porter's Five Forces
avoid_when: Mistaken for full company or customer analysis

name: Scenario planning + real options
best_for: Irreversible decisions under uncertainty and staged capital commitment
avoid_when: Used to disguise unsupported numeric precision

name: Amazon-style Working Backwards / PRFAQ
best_for: Stress-testing end-customer value before a build commitment

name: Lean experiments / pretotype testing
best_for: Testing highest-risk assumptions with lowest sufficient effort
avoid_when: Mock tests are passed off as revealed purchasing behavior

name: Business capability mapping
best_for: Finding operational capabilities, owners, dependencies and gaps
avoid_when: Only a narrow creative deliverable is needed

name: Decision records + pre-mortem
best_for: Preserving tradeoffs, owners, evidence and review triggers
